applicabilityBasis.summary: USD1 is a U.S. dollar payment stablecoin issued 1:1 via BitGo Trust infrastructure with reserve attestations and public redemption policy: squarely within the apparent-payment-stablecoin definition.

genius.licensingRegulator: OCC (BitGo Bank & Trust national trust bank; proposed World Liberty Trust Company received preliminary conditional charter approval August 14, 2026)
genius.notes: Issuer and charter update checked 2026-10-01: OCC Corporate Decision 1385, dated August 14, 2026, names BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A. as USD1's current exclusive issuer and custodian and grants World Liberty Trust Company preliminary conditional approval only. Final authorization to commence business requires completion of preopening requirements; the proposed bank intends to assume issuance and reserve liabilities from BitGo after establishment. The August 2026 KPMG reserve report continues to identify BitGo Bank & Trust as issuer. Preliminary national trust charter approval is not a token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, so the existing authorizationStatus is retained. The June 18, 2026 negative-authorization and enforcement review remains historical and has not been re-dated by this issuer-specific update.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official PPSI application was located for USD1. The January 2026 OCC charter filing by WLTC Holdings is a trust-charter application under existing OCC authority, not a GENIUS PPSI application.
